tools.name: vinsight_list_resources
tools.description: List the Vinsight API resources (endpoints) this token can reach, with their key names. Start here to find a resource name. Vinsight API: GET /Metadata.json.

tools.name: vinsight_describe_resource
tools.description: Get one resource's fields (type, nullable, read-only), navigation properties, writable child collections and custom actions. Use it before a create. Vinsight API: GET /Metadata/{Resource}.json?$expand=Metadata.

tools.name: vinsight_list_records
tools.description: List records of any Vinsight resource with OData $filter, $select, $orderby, $skip and $top. Use vinsight_list_resources to find the name. Vinsight API: GET /{Resource}.json.

tools.name: vinsight_get_record
tools.description: Get one record of any Vinsight resource by its key, with optional $select. Numeric keys such as 8821 work; string keys are encoded for you. Vinsight API: GET /{Resource}/{key}.json.

tools.name: vinsight_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers (Contacts) with filter, order and paging. Default fields: ContactNum, LegalName, IsActive. Vinsight API: GET /Contacts.json.

tools.name: vinsight_list_stock_items
tools.description: List stock items (products and SKUs) with filter, order and paging. Default fields: StockItemNum, StockItemCode, Description, BaseUOM. Vinsight API: GET /StockItems.json.

tools.name: vinsight_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with filter, order and paging. Default fields: SalesOrderNum, Status, InvoiceDate, ContactNum. Vinsight API: GET /SalesOrders.json.

tools.name: vinsight_create_sales_order
tools.description: Create a sales order for a contact, with optional line items. This writes a new numbered order that uses the next number in the sequence; it does not email anyone. Required: ContactNum, DivisionNum, CurrencyNum, InvoiceDate. Vinsight API: POST /SalesOrders.json.
